title: Analog Emitter
description:
The Analog Emitter is a block that allows you to easily produce analog redstone signals with a custom strength. If its input side (circle) is powered (strength is irrelevant) it will output a redstone signal of the strength specified in its gui on the other sides (Squares).

Right click it to open the gui. The < and > buttons change the signal strength by 1, from 0 to 15. The default strength is 1.

properties.label: Input
properties.value: Any redstone power on the circle side

properties.label: Output
properties.value: Configured strength on the other sides
